gaps.explanation: Debt Service Fund: governmental funds statement (p4) prints Miscellaneous 4,935 and Total revenues 68,168; the Debt Service Fund budgetary comparison schedule (p13, Actual Amounts (Budgetary Basis)) prints Miscellaneous 3,875 and Total revenues 67,108. 68,168 - 67,108 = 1,060 = the gap. All other funds tie: General 219,690 (p4 grant 5,915 + misc 32,906 = schedule Miscellaneous 38,821), Street 107,395, Other Governmental (Keno) 16,809. Schedule total 411,002 + 1,060 = statement 412,062. Both printed figures differ; no detail fix.

Debt Service Fund: p4 prints Principal 65,000 + Interest and other charges 3,155 = Total expenditures 68,155; the budgetary schedule (p13) prints Debt service 67,095. 68,155 - 67,095 = 1,060 = the gap. Other funds tie (General 130,908, Street 152,984, Other Governmental 50,190 = Park and Recreation 38,944 + Keno 11,246). 401,177 + 1,060 = 402,237. No detail fix.

Proprietary statement (p7) total operating expenses 355,236 + interest expense 3,973 = 359,209 includes Depreciation 52,750 and only interest; the Water (p14) and Sewer (p15) budgetary schedules exclude depreciation and print Sewer Debt service 43,853 (principal and interest, budgetary basis). Schedule 346,339 - 43,853 + 52,750 + 3,973 = 359,209 exactly. Different basis; no detail fix.
